t: When you are frightened of what might happen
a: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَآ إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَىٰنَا ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
p: Qul lan yuṣībanā illā mā kataba-llāhu lanā, huwa mawlānā, wa ʿala-llāhi fa-l-yatawakkali-l-mu'minūn.
m: Say, "Never will we be struck except by what Allāh has decreed for us; He is our protector." And upon Allāh let the believers rely.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
